answer: Replay audits: each agent stores the inputs and seeds behind its work in a cedar ledger, and every epoch a public beacon picks a few receipts for independent re-execution. Honest agents pass at no cost; a sybil farm faking output across many identities must forge every log. The rule is ferrous: one mismatched receipt freezes every key sharing that funding root. Auditors can't judge from an ivory tower either; they post their own replay transcripts, which are cross-checked.
